WESTBROOK STATE HIGHWAY PATROL — TRAFFIC COLLISION REPORT
Report No.: WSHP-2024-08-04-1109
Date/Time of Collision: 08/04/2024 07:42
Location: SR-9 EB, MM 14.2, Marion County
Weather: Clear, dry pavement
Investigating Officer: Trooper L. Anker #2218

PARTIES:
P-1 (Driver): Jordan K. Parrish, DOB 11/22/1989. Vehicle: 2021 Honda Civic, WA plate.
P-2 (Driver): Ethan M. Bray, DOB 07/14/1981. Vehicle: 2022 Freightliner Cascadia tractor + box trailer. Registered owner: NORTHRIDGE LOGISTICS, INC.

NARRATIVE:
Both vehicles were traveling eastbound on SR-9, a four-lane divided highway, posted speed 65 mph. P-2 was in lane #2 (center lane). P-1 was in lane #1 (right-of-center lane).

P-2 initiated a lane change from lane #2 to lane #1 without signaling. P-2's right-front tire and bumper made contact with P-1's left-rear quarter panel. P-1's vehicle was rotated counterclockwise approximately 180 degrees and struck the concrete median barrier with the front of the vehicle.

P-1 was extricated by Marion County Fire and transported by ALS ambulance to Westbrook Regional Medical Center. GCS at scene: 13. P-2 declined transport.

CITATIONS ISSUED:
- P-2: Westbrook Vehicle Code § 22107 (Unsafe Lane Change). Bond posted.

CONTRIBUTING FACTORS:
P-2: Unsafe lane change. Driver fatigue suspected — driver stated he had been "on the road since 8 last night."

EVIDENCE:
- Roadway skid/yaw marks photographed and measured.
- Three independent witnesses (see attached statements).
- P-2's vehicle equipped with forward-facing dashcam; footage preserved by employer.

End of report.
